headline: One in every three electric cars sold is Chinese-made, Korea's market changes dramatically
summary: More than one-third of electric vehicles sold in South Korea in the first half were made in China. Chinese-made EVs also overtook Germany in the imported car market for the first time.
why: South Korea is a major car market and home to large domestic automakers, so shifts in import share affect competition in the EV segment.
